title: Hexa Hotbar
description: A sleek, neon-themed minimalist HUD and hotbar overlay.
body:
# Hexa Hotbar

Give your Minecraft interface a fresh look with Hexa Hotbar. This pack replaces the standard vanilla hotbar with a sleek, dark design featuring vibrant neon purple and cyan accents.

### What you get:
* A dark hotbar container with glowing neon edges
* A clean, matching selection box for your active item
* Custom heart, food, air, and experience bar textures to match the neon theme

### Why download it?
If you want to swap the default look for a sharp, vibrant neon style that looks great while you play. It keeps your screen looking clean and simple without any unnecessary clutter.

### Important info:
* **Versions:** Works on Minecraft 1.21 through 1.21.11, plus the 26.1 and 26.2 releases.
* **Compatibility:** Works on all versions regardless of the loader (Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, etc.) since this is a standard resource pack.
* **Setup:** Just drop the zip file into your resourcepacks folder and activate it in the game menu.
